person_note: The diagnostic Goodreads passages repeatedly show Violet participating in the story and narrating as I/me/my, including clear interior and action beats. The authorized opening independently sustains the same first-person narration. Whole-book descriptions identify Violet as the primary first-person narrator and Xaden as the first-person narrator of the final chapter. Because both sustained narrators use first person, the narrator switch does not warrant ALTERNATING. Dialogue, epigraphs, and aphorisms were treated as non-base material. The authorized prose evidence is limited to the opening, but interior quote evidence and explicit whole-book structural descriptions corroborate it, with no credible contrary evidence.
